findings.description: The plan requires exact commands for Firebase deploy and realtime smoke ActionItems, but the shipped ActionItem constructor validates exact_command against the known DontPanic command vocabulary. The plan does not say whether those external Firebase commands become validated operator-only commands, wrapper commands, or a new validated command class, so the catalog can fail at construction or silently lose the exact command outcome.

Adding SOURCE_INTEGRATION and provide_integration_actions() is not enough to prove the standard operator surfaces render the items. The shipped dashboard collection path explicitly aggregates each provider and maintains per-source scope and freshness maps; the plan does not require wiring the new provider through that real collect_state/dashboard.build/write_cache path.

F002 says the static smoke captures run output as an evidence ref, while F004 consumes evidence refs to flip status, but no feature pins the evidence storage location, schema, write API, or clears_when predicate input. Without that contract, the smoke can pass and still fail the completion test requiring status to change without hand-editing.

F004's description correctly says there is no separate integrations panel and status must route through shipped what-now/operator-console surfaces, but its steps still instruct implementation to render a dashboard integrations panel. That contradicts the objective contract and can lock a UI path the source-of-truth decision explicitly removed.

The plan names statuses configured, deployed, smoke-passing, and pending, but it does not pin the per-integration matrix mapping catalog entries and evidence refs to each status. Firebase, static dashboard, Linear, and Discord have different evidence shapes, so two implementations could satisfy the prose while linking or clearing different pending items.

F003 says deploy and realtime-smoke items render gated or unavailable until trigger and credentials are present, but the trigger source and credential-presence semantics are not pinned. That leaves room for hiding gated items, probing real secrets, or making visibility depend on live environment state, all of which conflict with offline fixture proof and no-secret rendering.
